channel.title: The Oakland Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Oakland Press (theoaklandpress.com)

item.title: Jury finds Wisconsin man guilty of forging threat against Trump to get witness deported
item.description: The jury found Demetric Scott guilty of identity theft and witness intimidation.

item.title: Some blind fans to experience Super Bowl with tactile device that tracks ball
item.description: Some blind and low-vision fans will have unprecedented access to the Super Bowl thanks to a tactile device that tracks the ball, vibrates on key plays and provides real-time audio.

item.title: FACT FOCUS: A look at false and misleading claims made during Trump’s first Cabinet meeting of 2026
item.description: Some of the president's boasts were off the mark.

item.title: Olivia Olson scores season-high 27 points to help No. 9 Michigan beat struggling Indiana 95-67
item.description: Olivia Olson scored a season-high 27 points and Mila Holloway added 17 to help No. 9 Michigan beat Indiana 95-67 on Thursday night.

item.title: Grace VanSlooten scores 17 and No. 13 Michigan State women beat Purdue 86-65
item.description: Grace VanSlooten scored 17 points, Kennedy Blair had 15 points, eight rebounds, seven assists and five steals, and No. 13 Michigan State beat Purdue 86-65 on Thursday night.

item.title: Patrick Kane passes Mike Modano for the most NHL points by a US-born player
item.description: Patrick Kane smiled. The wait was over. Kane became the highest-scoring United States-born player in NHL history, passing Mike Modano with an assist for his 1,375th point on an assist Thursday night for the Detroit Red Wings against the Washington Capitals.

item.title: Photo gallery from Stoney Creek vs. West Bloomfield in an OAA Red girls hoops contest
item.description: Stoney Creek and West Bloomfield were tied with less than a minute left, but the Cougars pulled out a 41-38 win over the Lakers Thursday night in Rochester Hills.

item.title: Photos of Birmingham Groves vs. Bloomfield Hills in OAA White girls hoops action
item.description: The Birmingham Groves Falcons defeated the Bloomfield Hills Black Hawks 80-39 in the OAA White matchup played on Thursday night at Bloomfield Hills.

item.title: Groves wins 10th straight, takes control of league by beating Bloomfield Hills
item.description: Birmingham Groves dictated tempo from the start and raced to an 80-39 victory over Bloomfield Hills in a battle for first place in the Oakland Activities Association White Division.

item.title: Stoney Creek slips past West Bloomfield to remain unbeaten in OAA Red
item.description: Stoney Creek relied on the free-throw shooting of junior forward Calista Ivezaj to pull out a 41-38 win over visiting West Bloomfield on Thursday.
